en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. Under the official English text of the Estonia–Czech Republic tax treaty, dividends beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State may also be taxed in the source State, but the source-State tax is limited to 5 per cent of the gross amount where the beneficial owner is a company directly holding at least 25 per cent of the capital of the payer; in all other cases the ceiling is 15 per cent. The permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official English treaty text; the official text controls.

Article 11 — Interest. Under the official English text of the Estonia–Czech Republic tax treaty, interest beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State is generally subject to a 10 per cent source-State ceiling. Interest is taxable only in the residence State where the qualifying government, political subdivision, local authority, central bank, wholly government-owned financial institution or government-guaranteed financing exemption applies. The permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official English treaty text; the official text controls.

Article 12 — Royalties. Under the official English text of the Estonia–Czech Republic tax treaty, royalties beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State may also be taxed in the source State, but the source-State tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount. The permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official English treaty text; the official text controls.
